Camera-search episodes additionally require actual issued/completed bounded pose receipts and post-pose fresh RGB. All intervals use original timestamps; old anchors never become current drive evidence.
boundary_audit: saved RGB byte hashes and paired frame/time
at most 3 episodes and 3 poses per episode, 4 s from first HOLD
known fail reason with final exact HOLD and no resumed drive
promotion: No automatic qualification or default change. Only after both diagnostics pass, preregister a separate matched comparison on final frozen code. Never use failed-run wall time as a speed gain.
preservation: Keep every started failure, raw video/RGB/decisions/commands, standard manager manifest, freeze/launch/audit and unstarted denominator. Add completed results including failure to a fresh native TensorBoard snapshot.
